mapper.select: INSERT INTO iam_refresh_token_families (identity_id, family_purpose, membership_id, tenant_id, last_used_at, absolute_expires_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{row.identityId}, #{row.familyPurpose}, #{row.membershipId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.lastUsedAt}, #{row.absoluteExpiresAt}, #{row.revokedAt}) RETURNING id, identity_id, family_purpose, membership_id, tenant_id, last_used_at, absolute_expires_at, revoked_at

INSERT INTO iam_refresh_tokens (family_id, token_digest, issued_at, consumed_at) VALUES (#{row.familyId}, #{row.tokenDigest}, #{row.issuedAt}, #{row.consumedAt}) RETURNING id, family_id, token_digest, issued_at, consumed_at
SELECT id, family_id, token_digest, issued_at, consumed_at FROM iam_refresh_tokens WHERE token_digest = #{tokenDigest} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, identity_id, family_purpose, membership_id, tenant_id, last_used_at, absolute_expires_at, revoked_at FROM iam_refresh_token_families WHERE id = #{familyId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_refresh_token_families SET family_purpose = #{row.familyPurpose}, membership_id = #{row.membershipId}, tenant_id = #{row.tenantId}, last_used_at = #{row.lastUsedAt}, absolute_expires_at = #{row.absoluteExpiresAt}, revoked_at = #{row.revokedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id}
